title: Amigos
overview: Amigos" (Friends) is an 18-minute Spanish thriller that explores the lifelong bonds, hidden tensions, and evolving dynamics within a group of childhood friends as they transition into adulthood.The narrative jumps across time, tracking the central characters—Juanjo, Miguel, Paco, and Nacho—from their days as children and adolescents to their lives as grown men. When the adult version of Juanjo (played by Fele Martínez) and Miguel (Sergio Otegui) confront the realities of their mature lives, old secrets and underlying friction from their past come to a head.
